EcoWatch never asks this app for your location. The coordinates you see on a task belong to the report a resident filed, and they are used so you can find the reported spot and upload the right photos.
Before and after photos are attached to the assignment so an administrator can review the cleanup. They are visible to your administrators and are never posted publicly.

How to use EcoWatch Personnel

1. Accept a task from My Tasks as soon as you can, so residents know it is being handled.
2. Upload at least one Before Cleaning photo, then tap Start Cleaning.
3. Add an After Cleaning photo and tap Mark as Completed. An administrator reviews the cleanup afterwards.
4. Task History keeps every assignment this account has received, so you can check what is still open.

If the server cannot be reached, check that you are on the same network as the server and that the address in Server settings is still correct.

Terms of use

- Use this app only for cleaning work you have been assigned by an administrator.
- Before and after photos must show the area you were asked to clean. Do not upload photos of people, homes or number plates.
- Task locations and photos are visible to EcoWatch administrators and are never published.
- Do not share your account or let anyone else use your signed-in device.

Privacy

EcoWatch stores your account details, your assignments and the photos you upload. It does not collect your location, your contacts or your browsing history.

About EcoWatch Personnel

EcoWatch Personnel is the companion app for the waste-management personnel who carry out the cleanups residents report through EcoWatch. It is the field half of one system: residents file reports, administrators review and assign them, and this app is where the assigned cleaner accepts the task, photographs the area before and after, and submits the work for approval.

Every assignment in this app comes from a resident report. Nothing here is entered by hand, so a task always names the place and the problem a resident described.

What you can do here

Receive every assignment
Administrators assign reported problems to the cleaners who cover that area. All of your assignments appear in My Tasks, and Task History keeps the ones that have moved on.

Accept and track work
A task moves from Assigned to Accepted to In Progress to Completed. Each step is recorded with a timestamp, so the history shows exactly when the work was picked up and when it was finished.

Prove the cleanup
Before and after photos are required. The before photo documents the reported problem; the after photo shows what your team did about it. An administrator reviews both before closing the task, and residents can see when their report is resolved.

Stay on top of assignments
The app tells you when you are given new work, and when a task you completed has been approved, so you are not left guessing.

Keep your own record
Task History stores every assignment on this device. You can look up what you worked on, when you worked on it and what you submitted, even without a connection.

Our purpose

EcoWatch exists to make community cleanups visible and accountable. Residents report, personnel clean, administrators verify. See it. Report it. Clean it. Prove it.
